_doc: Player profiles for hh-sim (docs/simulator.md, Profiles). attention: real seconds between looks (the player acts at each look). speeds: which speed the player runs at and when it changes; speeds are the web client's (1, 3, 10, 50, 200 ticks a real second). fixed: always `speed`. adaptive: `busy` after a look where the player acted, `idle` after one where it didn't. ramp: `speeds[k]` with k the career's retirements so far (the last for every later run).

casual.says: looks in every couple of minutes

afk.says: leaves it running, back every half hour

ramp.says: faster each retirement: 1x in run 1 up to 200x from run 5
